column2:
racial(adj.)種族的
race(n.)種族、賽跑
racism(n.)種族歧視
racial discrimination 種族歧視
racial equality 種族平等
Racial discrimination should not be allowed in any school.
(任何學校都不應容許種族歧視。)
Martin Luther King Jr. fought for racial equality in America.
(馬丁‧路德‧金恩為美國的種族平等奮鬥。)

rag(n.)破布、抹布
ragged(adj.)破爛的
in rags 衣衫襤褸
from rags to riches 從貧窮到致富
She wiped the dirty table with an old rag.
(她用一條舊抹布擦髒桌子。)
His life story is a true tale of rags to riches.
(他的人生故事是一個白手起家的真實例子。)

rank(n./v.)等級、階級、排名
ranking(n.)排名
rank first 排名第一
high rank 高階級
Our school ranks first in the city basketball league.
(我們學校在全市籃球聯賽中排名第一。)
He was promoted to a higher rank in the army.
(他在軍中晉升到更高的軍階。)

rate(n./v.)比率、速度、費用、評價
rating(n.)評分、等級
birth rate 出生率
at any rate 無論如何
Taiwan's birth rate has dropped in recent years.
(台灣的出生率近年來下降了。)
Many viewers rated the new drama very highly.
(許多觀眾給這部新劇很高的評價。)

raw(adj.)生的、未加工的
(無詞性變化)
raw fish 生魚
raw materials 原料
Some people do not like to eat raw fish.
(有些人不喜歡吃生魚。)
The factory imports raw materials from other countries.
(那間工廠從其他國家進口原料。)

ray(n.)光線、射線
(無詞性變化)
rays of sunlight 陽光
get an X-ray 照X光
The first rays of sunlight came through the window.
(第一道陽光透過窗戶照進來。)
The doctor asked me to take an X-ray of my arm.
(醫生要我的手臂照X光。)

razor(n.)剃刀、刮鬍刀
(無詞性變化)
electric razor 電動刮鬍刀
razor blade 刮鬍刀片
My father uses an electric razor every morning.
(我爸爸每天早上用電動刮鬍刀。)
Be careful, the razor blade is very sharp.
(小心，這個刮鬍刀片非常鋒利。)

react(v.)反應、回應
reaction(n.)反應
reactor(n.)反應爐
react to 對……做出反應
react quickly 迅速反應
How did your parents react to the news?
(你父母對這個消息有什麼反應？)
The driver reacted quickly and avoided the accident.
(司機迅速反應，避開了車禍。)

reaction(n.)反應
react(v.)反應、回應
chemical reaction 化學反應
reaction to 對……的反應
Fire is the result of a chemical reaction.
(火是化學反應的結果。)
Her first reaction to the gift was surprise.
(她對這份禮物的第一個反應是驚訝。)

reasonable(adj.)合理的、講理的、價格公道的
reason(n.)理由、理性
reasonably(adv.)合理地、相當
reasonable price 合理的價格
reasonable request 合理的要求
The restaurant serves good food at reasonable prices.
(那家餐廳以合理的價格提供美味的食物。)
It is reasonable to ask for more time to finish the project.
(要求更多時間完成這項專題是合理的。)

receipt(n.)收據、收到
receive(v.)收到
keep the receipt 保留收據
on receipt of 一收到……就
Please keep the receipt in case you want to return it.
(請保留收據，以防你想退貨。)
Taiwanese people often check their receipts for the lottery.
(台灣人常常對發票看有沒有中獎。)

receiver(n.)接收者、聽筒、接收器
receive(v.)收到
pick up the receiver 拿起聽筒
the receiver of 收件人
She picked up the receiver and said hello.
(她拿起聽筒說聲哈囉。)
The receiver of the letter must sign for it.
(收件人必須簽收這封信。)

recognize(v.)認出、承認、認可
recognition(n.)認出、認可
recognizable(adj.)可辨認的
recognize someone 認出某人
be recognized as 被公認為
I didn't recognize you with your new haircut.
(你剪了新髮型，我都認不出你了。)
She is recognized as one of the best writers in Taiwan.
(她被公認為台灣最優秀的作家之一。)

recorder(n.)錄音機、記錄器、直笛
record(v./n.)記錄、紀錄
recording(n.)錄音、錄影
voice recorder 錄音筆
play the recorder 吹直笛
The reporter used a voice recorder during the interview.
(記者在訪問時使用錄音筆。)
Most students in Taiwan learn to play the recorder in elementary school.
(台灣大部分學生在國小學吹直笛。)

rectangle(n.)長方形、矩形
rectangular(adj.)長方形的
draw a rectangle 畫長方形
area of a rectangle 長方形的面積
Please draw a rectangle on the board.
(請在黑板上畫一個長方形。)
We learned how to find the area of a rectangle.
(我們學了如何求長方形的面積。)

reduce(v.)減少、降低
reduction(n.)減少、降低
reduce waste 減少浪費
reduce the risk 降低風險
We should reduce plastic waste to protect the ocean.
(我們應該減少塑膠垃圾以保護海洋。)
Regular exercise can reduce the risk of heart disease.
(規律運動可以降低心臟病的風險。)

regional(adj.)地區的、區域的
region(n.)地區、區域
regional food 地方特色料理
regional differences 地區差異
Every county in Taiwan has its own regional food.
(台灣每個縣市都有自己的地方特色料理。)
There are regional differences in the way people speak.
(人們說話的方式有地區上的差異。)

regret(v./n.)後悔、遺憾
regretful(adj.)後悔的
regrettable(adj.)令人遺憾的
regret doing 後悔做了……
have no regrets 不後悔
I regret not studying harder for the exam.
(我後悔沒有更用功準備考試。)
She has no regrets about choosing this school.
(她對選擇這所學校一點也不後悔。)

relax(v.)放鬆、休息
relaxation(n.)放鬆、休閒
relaxed(adj.)放鬆的
relaxing(adj.)令人放鬆的
relax and enjoy 放鬆享受
feel relaxed 感到放鬆
Take a deep breath and try to relax before the speech.
(演講前深呼吸，試著放輕鬆。)
Listening to soft music helps me relax after school.
(聽輕柔的音樂幫助我在放學後放鬆。)

release(n./v.)釋放、發行、發布
(無詞性變化)
release a new album 發行新專輯
press release 新聞稿
The singer will release a new album next month.
(那位歌手下個月將發行新專輯。)
The injured bird was released after it got better.
(那隻受傷的鳥康復後被放生了。)

reliable(adj.)可靠的、可信賴的
rely(v.)依賴、信賴
reliability(n.)可靠性
reliable source 可靠的來源
reliable friend 可靠的朋友
Make sure your information comes from a reliable source.
(要確定你的資訊來自可靠的來源。)
This old car is still very reliable.
(這輛舊車仍然非常可靠。)

relief(n.)放心、緩解、救濟
relieve(v.)減輕、緩和
relieved(adj.)放心的
to one's relief 令某人鬆一口氣的是
pain relief 止痛
To my relief, everyone arrived home safely.
(令我鬆一口氣的是，大家都平安到家了。)
The government sent food and water as relief for the flood victims.
(政府送去食物和飲水救濟水災災民。)

religious(adj.)宗教的、虔誠的
religion(n.)宗教
religious belief 宗教信仰
religious festival 宗教節慶
Mazu's birthday is an important religious festival in Taiwan.
(媽祖誕辰是台灣重要的宗教節慶。)
People should respect each other's religious beliefs.
(人們應該尊重彼此的宗教信仰。)

rely(v.)依賴、信賴
reliable(adj.)可靠的
reliance(n.)依賴
rely on 依賴、信賴
can rely on 可以信賴
You can always rely on me when you need help.
(你需要幫忙時隨時可以信賴我。)
Many students rely too much on their cell phones.
(許多學生太過依賴手機。)

remain(v.)保持、仍然是、留下
remains(n.)遺跡、剩餘物
remaining(adj.)剩下的
remain silent 保持沉默
remain calm 保持冷靜
Please remain calm during the earthquake.
(地震時請保持冷靜。)
Only a few cookies remained after the party.
(派對後只剩下幾片餅乾。)

remind(v.)提醒、使想起
reminder(n.)提醒物、提示
remind A of B 使A想起B
remind A to do 提醒A做某事
Please remind me to bring my textbook tomorrow.
(請提醒我明天要帶課本。)
This song reminds me of my childhood.
(這首歌讓我想起我的童年。)

remote(adj.)遙遠的、偏僻的、遠端的
remotely(adv.)遙遠地、遠端地
remote control 遙控器
remote area 偏遠地區
Can you pass me the remote control?
(你可以把遙控器遞給我嗎？)
Some volunteers teach children in remote areas.
(有些志工在偏遠地區教小朋友。)

replace(v.)取代、替換、replacement(n.)替換、替代品
(無詞性變化)
replace A with B 用B取代A
find a replacement 找人接替
We need to replace the old light bulb with a new one.
(我們需要把舊燈泡換成新的。)
The coach is looking for a replacement for the injured player.
(教練正在找受傷球員的替補人選。)

represent(v.)代表、象徵、表示
representative(n./adj.)代表、代表性的
representation(n.)代表、表現
represent the school 代表學校
represent peace 象徵和平
She will represent our school in the speech contest.
(她將代表我們學校參加演講比賽。)
The white dove represents peace.
(白鴿象徵和平。)

representative(adj./n.)代表性的、代表
represent(v.)代表
class representative 班代
sales representative 業務代表
Our class representative will attend the student meeting.
(我們的班代將出席學生會議。)
This painting is representative of his early works.
(這幅畫可以代表他早期的作品。)

republic(n.)共和國
republican(adj./n.)共和國的、共和主義者
Republic of China 中華民國
democratic republic 民主共和國
The Republic of China was founded in 1912.
(中華民國成立於一九一二年。)
France is a republic, not a kingdom.
(法國是共和國，不是王國。)

request(n./v.)請求、要求
(無詞性變化)
make a request 提出請求
on request 應要求
The teacher agreed to our request for more time.
(老師答應了我們延長時間的請求。)
Visitors are requested to turn off their phones.
(參觀者請關閉手機。)

reserve(n./v.)預訂、保留、儲備
reservation(n.)預訂
reserved(adj.)預訂的、內向的
reserve a table 訂位
nature reserve 自然保護區
We reserved a table for six at the restaurant.
(我們在餐廳訂了六人的位子。)
This seat is reserved for the elderly.
(這個座位是保留給年長者的。)

resist(v.)抵抗、抗拒、忍住
resistance(n.)抵抗
resistant(adj.)有抵抗力的
resist temptation 抵抗誘惑
can't resist 忍不住
I can't resist eating chocolate when I see it.
(我看到巧克力就忍不住要吃。)
The village people resisted the enemy for many days.
(村民抵抗敵人好幾天。)

resource(n.)資源
resourceful(adj.)足智多謀的
natural resources 天然資源
human resources 人力資源
Taiwan does not have many natural resources.
(台灣沒有很多天然資源。)
The library is a great resource for students.
(圖書館對學生來說是很好的資源。)

response(n.)回應、反應、答覆
respond(v.)回應、回答
responsive(adj.)反應靈敏的
in response to 回應……
quick response 快速回應
In response to the heavy rain, schools were closed.
(因應豪大雨，學校停課了。)
I sent an email but got no response.
(我寄了電子郵件，但沒有收到回覆。)

responsibility(n.)責任、職責
responsible(adj.)負責的
take responsibility for 為……負責
sense of responsibility 責任感
You must take responsibility for your own actions.
(你必須為自己的行為負責。)
Taking care of a pet teaches children a sense of responsibility.
(照顧寵物能教導孩子責任感。)

restrict(v.)限制、約束
restriction(n.)限制
restricted(adj.)受限制的
restrict to 限制在……
restricted area 管制區
The use of phones is restricted during class.
(上課期間限制使用手機。)
Visitors are not allowed in the restricted area.
(訪客不准進入管制區。)

reveal(v.)揭露、透露、顯示
revelation(n.)揭露、啟示
reveal a secret 洩漏秘密
reveal the truth 揭露真相
She refused to reveal the secret to anyone.
(她拒絕向任何人透露這個秘密。)
The report revealed that many teens do not get enough sleep.
(報告顯示許多青少年睡眠不足。)

ribbon(n.)緞帶、絲帶
(無詞性變化)
tie a ribbon 繫緞帶
cut the ribbon 剪綵
She tied a red ribbon around the gift box.
(她在禮物盒上繫了一條紅色緞帶。)
The mayor cut the ribbon at the opening of the new library.
(市長在新圖書館開幕時剪綵。)

rid(adj./v.)擺脫的、使擺脫、除去
(無詞性變化)
get rid of 擺脫、丟掉
be rid of 擺脫
I want to get rid of my bad habit of staying up late.
(我想改掉熬夜的壞習慣。)
We finally got rid of all the old furniture.
(我們終於把所有舊家具處理掉了。)

ripe(adj.)成熟的
ripen(v.)使成熟、變成熟
ripe fruit 成熟的水果
ripe old age 高齡
These bananas are not ripe yet.
(這些香蕉還沒熟。)
My great-grandmother lived to a ripe old age of 98.
(我曾祖母活到九十八歲的高齡。)

risk(n./v.)風險、冒險
risky(adj.)有風險的
take a risk 冒險
at risk 有危險
He took a big risk by starting his own business.
(他自己創業冒了很大的風險。)
Smoking puts your health at risk.
(抽菸會讓你的健康陷入危險。)

roar(n./v.)吼叫、咆哮、轟鳴
(無詞性變化)
roar of laughter 哄堂大笑
roar of the engine 引擎的轟鳴聲
The lion roared loudly in its cage.
(獅子在籠子裡大聲吼叫。)
His joke was followed by a roar of laughter.
(他的笑話引起一陣哄堂大笑。)

roast(adj./n./v.)烤的、烤肉、烘烤
(無詞性變化)
roast chicken 烤雞
roast duck 烤鴨
We had roast chicken for dinner on Christmas.
(我們聖誕節晚餐吃烤雞。)
My father roasts sweet potatoes in the oven.
(我爸爸用烤箱烤地瓜。)

rob(v.)搶劫、剝奪
robber(n.)強盜、搶匪
robbery(n.)搶劫
rob a bank 搶銀行
rob A of B 搶走A的B
Two men robbed the bank last night.
(兩名男子昨晚搶劫了那家銀行。)
The thief robbed the old woman of her purse.
(小偷搶走那位老婦人的錢包。)

robbery(n.)搶劫、搶案
rob(v.)搶劫
robber(n.)強盜、搶匪
armed robbery 持械搶劫
bank robbery 銀行搶案
The police are looking into the bank robbery.
(警方正在調查那起銀行搶案。)
The store was the scene of an armed robbery.
(這家店發生過一起持械搶劫案。)

robe(n.)長袍、浴袍
(無詞性變化)
bathrobe 浴袍
graduation robe 畢業袍
She put on a robe after taking a shower.
(她洗完澡後穿上浴袍。)
All the graduates wore black graduation robes.
(所有畢業生都穿著黑色的畢業袍。)

rocket(n.)火箭
(無詞性變化)
launch a rocket 發射火箭
rocket science 高深的學問
The rocket was launched into space this morning.
(火箭今天早上發射升空。)
Don't worry, cooking pasta isn't rocket science.
(別擔心，煮義大利麵又不是什麼高深的學問。)

romantic(adj./n.)浪漫的、浪漫的人
romance(n.)愛情、浪漫
romantic dinner 浪漫晚餐
romantic comedy 浪漫喜劇
They had a romantic dinner by the sea.
(他們在海邊享用浪漫的晚餐。)
My sister loves watching romantic comedies.
(我姊姊很愛看浪漫喜劇。)

rot(v./n.)腐爛、腐壞
rotten(adj.)腐爛的
rot away 爛掉
start to rot 開始腐爛
The apples began to rot after a week in the hot room.
(蘋果在悶熱的房間裡放了一週後開始腐爛。)
Too much sugar can cause your teeth to rot.
(吃太多糖可能導致蛀牙。)

rotten(adj.)腐爛的、糟糕的
rot(v./n.)腐爛
rotten egg 臭雞蛋
feel rotten 感覺很糟
The kitchen smelled like rotten eggs.
(廚房聞起來像臭雞蛋。)
I felt rotten after eating too much fried food.
(吃了太多油炸食物後我覺得很不舒服。)

rough(adj./adv./n.)粗糙的、粗略的、艱難的
roughly(adv.)大約、粗暴地
rough idea 大概的想法
rough day 辛苦的一天
I had a rough day at school today.
(我今天在學校過得很辛苦。)
His hands are rough from years of farm work.
(他的雙手因多年務農而粗糙。)

roughly(adv.)大約、粗略地、粗暴地
rough(adj.)粗糙的、粗略的
roughly speaking 大致說來
roughly half 大約一半
Roughly half of the students take the bus to school.
(大約一半的學生搭公車上學。)
Roughly speaking, the trip will take three hours.
(大致說來，這趟旅程要花三個小時。)

routine(n./adj.)例行公事、慣例、例行的
routinely(adv.)例行地
daily routine 日常作息
routine check 例行檢查
Exercise is part of my daily routine.
(運動是我日常作息的一部分。)
The doctor gave me a routine check.
(醫生幫我做了例行檢查。)

rug(n.)小地毯
(無詞性變化)
sweep under the rug 掩蓋
soft rug 柔軟的地毯
The cat is sleeping on the rug by the fire.
(貓咪睡在爐火旁的地毯上。)
Don't sweep your problems under the rug.
(不要把你的問題掩蓋起來。)

rumor(n./v.)謠言、傳聞、謠傳
rumour(n.)謠言(英式拼法)
spread a rumor 散播謠言
rumor has it that 謠傳……
Someone spread a rumor that our teacher was leaving.
(有人散播謠言說我們老師要離職了。)
Rumor has it that the singer will visit Taiwan.
(謠傳那位歌手將來台灣。)

rush(n./v.)匆忙、急速、衝
(無詞性變化)
rush hour 尖峰時間
in a rush 匆忙地
The MRT is very crowded during rush hour.
(捷運在尖峰時間非常擁擠。)
He rushed to the hospital after hearing the news.
(他聽到消息後趕到醫院。)

rust(n./v.)鐵鏽、生鏽
rusty(adj.)生鏽的、生疏的
covered in rust 布滿鐵鏽
rusty English 生疏的英文
The old bike was covered in rust.
(那台舊腳踏車布滿鐵鏽。)
Iron will rust if you leave it out in the rain.
(鐵如果放在外面淋雨就會生鏽。)
